to: everyone: every socket on the server (`broadcast`), also sockets with no character

fields.name: message
fields.description: The English text. From the admin `notice` handler: the `message` of the request, with no check of its type.

fields.name: phrase
fields.description: The phrase key. Absent on an admin notice.

fields.name: phrase_args
fields.description: The values for the phrase. Absent on an admin notice.

confirm.note: `broadcast` sets `color: "orange"` on the object only after the emit (node/server_functions.js:3502-3504), so clients never get it.

senders.what: The admin `notice` handler (`pass` must be the master key): `{message}` only.
An event monster: the event is over, or the monster was defeated.
Goo Brawl: it is about to start, it has begun, it is over.
